requestedEvidence.item: A traceable intervention or maintenance record for source KAZ_S_159 that explicitly links the completed action to observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd, identifies the facility or plume location, describes the intervention, and gives the actual completion timestamp with timezone.

The underlying post-action methane measurement report or data for the same source/location, acquired strictly after the documented action and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC. Include the observation time and timezone, measurement method and sensor/platform, measured flux and unit, uncertainty and detection limit, quality or calibration information, and a stable report/data identifier.

For any linked external report referenced by the source, provide its stable identifier and public URL where available, issuer, report/version date, relevant report body and measurement metadata, and provenance sufficient to trace the result to KAZ_S_159 and the stated observation.

output.whyNeeded: The source-level feedback and notification fields do not document a completed intervention or a measurement after that intervention. The July 11 plume record is later than the selected observation, but without an action timestamp it cannot be classified as pre-action or post-action. Original, traceable action and measurement records are needed to evaluate the specific claim without treating a notification, feedback, missing observation, or DEMO note as proof of an outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: The action record identifies sourceId KAZ_S_159 and explicitly links to observationId 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd; it includes the site/location, intervention performed, completion status, and an actual completion timestamp with an explicit timezone or UTC conversion.
The documented action completion is on or before the scope end date 2026-07-31 UTC.

The follow-up measurement identifies the same source/site or plume footprint, has an acquisition timestamp strictly after the documented action and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC, and is linked by a stable observation or report identifier.

The measurement record states the method, sensor/platform, flux value and units, uncertainty, detection limit, and relevant quality/calibration information. It reports non-detection as non-detection and does not equate it with zero emissions.

Each record has traceable provenance: issuer or custodian, stable document/data ID, report or dataset version/date, and a public source URL where available. The evidence distinguishes directly observed results from interpretation and supports any outcome wording within the supplied scope.
